theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.79%) and Communication Svcs (+0.30%) led the market today, while Energy (-3.33%) and Health Care (-1.83%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.19% versus -0.48% for defensives and -1.30% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.44% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -1.11%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.41%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 3.50% to 24.56, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.83% to $3,755.30, crude oil was little changed at $82.90, and bitcoin slipped 0.48% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
